lines.english: School is over.

lines.serbian: Luka i Marko trče napolje sa loptom.
lines.croatian: Luka i Marko trče van s loptom.
lines.english: Luka and Marko run outside with a ball.

lines.serbian: Njihovi drugovi već čekaju na igralištu.
lines.croatian: Njihovi prijatelji već čekaju na igralištu.
lines.english: Their friends are already waiting at the playground.
"Who's playing?" asks Luka.
"Everyone!" shout the children.

lines.serbian: Stavljaju torbe na zemlju. To su golovi.
lines.croatian: Stavljaju torbe na zemlju. To su golovi.
lines.english: They put their bags on the ground. Those are the goals.

lines.serbian: Mia je na golu. Ona je najbolja golmanka.
lines.croatian: Mia je na golu. Ona je najbolja vratarka.
lines.english: Mia is in goal. She's the best goalkeeper.
Luka gets the ball and runs.
He shoots!
The ball flies over the fence.
It lands in Mrs Petrović's yard.
The children stand there in silence.

lines.serbian: Niko neće da ide po loptu.
lines.croatian: Nitko ne želi ići po loptu.
lines.english: Nobody wants to go and get the ball.
Then the door opens.
Mrs Petrović comes out with the ball.

lines.serbian: – Da li je ovo vaše? – pita.
lines.english: "Is this yours?" she asks.
"Yes. Sorry!" Luka says quietly.

lines.serbian: Ona baca loptu deci i smeje se.
lines.croatian: Ona baca loptu djeci i smije se.
lines.english: She throws the ball to the children and laughs.

lines.serbian: – Igrajte! Ali gol je tamo, a ne kod mene!
lines.croatian: – Igrajte! Ali gol je tamo, a ne kod mene!
lines.english: "Play! But the goal is over there, not at my house!"
The mums call the children in for dinner.
"Again tomorrow?" asks Mia.
"Again tomorrow!"
